biography:
I support de-risking billion-dollar digital infrastructure investments by translating construction realities into financial outcomes.

With over 14 years in mission-critical development, I’ve led $28.7B+ in cost strategies and delivered 4.8 GW of hyperscale data center capacity nationwide. My expertise lies in turning volatile project variables—power delivery, switchgear lead times, copper price swings, and labor constraints—into predictable financial models that drive confident underwriting and protect investor returns.

I operate at the intersection of capital and construction:
	•	For investors, I validate pro formas and uncover risks before capital is deployed.
	•	For developers, I compress deal timelines through precision cost intelligence and schedule certainty.
	•	For operators, I ensure scalable, repeatable delivery that builds tenant trust and long-term portfolio value.

Whether evaluating billion-dollar costs on hyperscale campuses or guiding procurement strategy for critical infrastructure, my focus is clear: protect capital, predictability, and accelerate the future of digital infrastructure.
